Find a Cartesian equation of the plane that passes through the point P(1,0,3) and is parallel to the vectors v1=⟨5,2,1⟩ and v2=⟨0,3,3⟩.

a
x+5y+5z+16=0
b
5x−2y+z+16=0
c
5x−2y+z=0
d
x−5y+5z−16=0

x−5y+5z=0
